$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNG (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Montpellier - Candillargues

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

reportingPoints.name: AM
reportingPoints.location: Remparts of the medieval city of Aigues Mortes

reportingPoints.name: ER
reportingPoints.location: North road interchange D62/D61 north of La Grande Motte

notes: Parallel TWY not available after heavy rainfalls.
Site likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Particular caution must be observed by LFNG users on heavy commercial and training activity in Montpellier CTR.
A request for clearance from Montpellier TWR 118.775 is mandatory before entering Montpellier CTR.
After take-off, risk of intrusion into Montpellier CTR, due to its proximity: Take-off from QFU 322°: turn right and avoid Mudaison and Baillargues.
Take-off from QFU 142°: turn left, and stay north of the «Rhône à Sète» canal,; direct to ER and/or AM prohibited without clearance from Montpellier TWR.
Traffic circuits: Bypass Candillargues via North.
Cross-wind leg QFU 322° or base leg QFU 142° is located midway between built-up areas of Mudaison and Candillargues.
Downwind leg exclusively East of Berange river.
